en: A sepia-toned staged photograph depicting two women in traditional dresses standing behind a rustic wooden fence, interacting playfully with three men in early 20th-century European military uniforms. The men are posing in jovial attitudes, one kneeling and gesturing towards a woman, while another holds a rifle. The background is a painted pastoral studio backdrop, typical of early photographic postcards.
